name: SmartTagProperty
description: Represents a single instance of a custom property for a smart tag. The SmartTagProperty object is a member of the SmartTagProperties collection.
remarks: To return a SmartTagProperty object, use the Item method of the SmartTagProperties collection, or use SmartTagProperties (index), where index is the number of the property. To return the information related to a custom property for a smart tag, use the Name and Value properties of the SmartTagProperty object.

properties.name: Name
properties.description: Use the Name property to specify or determine the string expression that identifies the name of an object. Read/write String.

properties.name: Value
properties.description: Gets or sets the value of the specified object. Read/write Variant.
